title: Technology Trends Outlook 2024
notes: 100-page report, 15 trends in five groups. Equity investment (2023, $ billion) and job-postings change (2022–23) per trend in notes. Adoption score (1-5, 2023) is graphical only and not recorded. rank = contents order; forecast entries carry their trend's rank.

entries.label: Generative AI
entries.quote: Generative AI (gen AI) has been making significant strides, pushing the boundaries of machine capabilities.
entries.subject: Generative AI
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $36 billion; job postings 2022–23: +111%.

entries.label: Generative AI
entries.quote: As we progress through 2024 and beyond, we anticipate organizations investing in the risk mitigation, operating model, talent, and technological capabilities required to scale gen AI.
entries.subject: Generative AI enterprise investment

entries.label: Applied AI
entries.quote: As we navigate through 2024, the impact of analytical AI technologies, including applications of machine learning (ML), computer vision, and natural-language processing (NLP), continues to grow across all sectors.
entries.subject: Applied AI
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $86 billion; job postings 2022–23: –29%.

entries.label: Industrializing machine learning
entries.quote: Industrializing machine learning (ML), also known as machine learning operations (MLOps), is the process of scaling and maintaining ML applications within enterprises.
entries.subject: MLOps
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $3 billion; job postings 2022–23: –36%.

entries.label: Next-generation software development
entries.quote: The landscape of software development is currently experiencing a transformative shift, driven by an influx of cutting-edge technologies such as generative AI (gen AI) and cloud-native architectures.
entries.subject: Software development tooling (low-code, AI-assisted)
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $17 billion; job postings 2022–23: –37%.

entries.label: Digital trust and cybersecurity
entries.quote: Digital trust and cybersecurity enable organizations to manage technology and data risks, accelerate innovation, and protect assets.
entries.subject: Digital trust and cybersecurity
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $34 billion; job postings 2022–23: –34%. Renamed from 'Trust architectures and digital identity' (2022-2023).

entries.label: Advanced connectivity
entries.quote: Advanced-connectivity technologies can potentially revolutionize the experiences of consumers and industries such as mobility, manufacturing, and agriculture.
entries.subject: Advanced connectivity
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $29 billion; job postings 2022–23: –24%.

entries.label: Immersive-reality technologies
entries.quote: Immersive-reality technologies allow users to experience an augmented form of our world or virtual worlds while uncovering a series of new use cases for consumers and enterprises alike.
entries.subject: Immersive reality (AR/VR/MR)
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $6 billion; job postings 2022–23: –36%.

entries.label: Cloud and edge computing
entries.quote: Cloud and edge computing has amplified AI capabilities for both training and inferencing on foundational models and will continue to be a major driver for the adoption of these technologies.
entries.subject: Cloud and edge computing
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $54 billion; job postings 2022–23: –38%. Opening sentence split across columns; a later sentence is quoted.

entries.label: Cloud and edge computing
entries.quote: The rise of AI in 2023 resulted in a massive increase in cloud and edge usage, with a CAGR of approximately 30.9 percent expected in the cloud AI market between 2023 and 2030
entries.subject: Cloud AI market
entries.metric: CAGR of the cloud AI market 2023–2030
entries.note: Footnote cites Fortune Business Insights (cloud AI market) and Gartner.

entries.label: Cloud and edge computing
entries.quote: While 2023 was mostly focused on training foundation models for AI, companies are expected to begin performing inference at scale on their models in 2024.
entries.subject: AI inference at scale

entries.label: Quantum technologies
entries.quote: In 2023, we saw steady progress on both the hardware and software fronts while organizations took more practical steps to ensure that their infrastructure and security are ready for the technology.
entries.subject: Quantum technologies
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $1 billion; job postings 2022–23: –17%. Opening sentence split across columns; a later sentence is quoted.

entries.label: Future of robotics
entries.quote: From a technological perspective, AI has led to many innovations that have increased the capabilities and accelerated the training of physical robots.
entries.subject: Robotics
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $6 billion; job postings 2022–23: –20%. New trend in 2024. Opening sentence split across columns; a later sentence is quoted.

entries.label: Future of mobility
entries.quote: Technical advancements, coupled with rising sustainability concerns, have given rise to a new era of mobility.
entries.subject: Mobility (autonomous, connected, electric, shared)
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $83 billion; job postings 2022–23: –5%.

entries.label: Future of mobility
entries.quote: approximately 30 battery factories are currently planned, being constructed, or operational in the United States alone; 13 of them are expected to open by 2025.
entries.subject: US battery factories

entries.label: Future of mobility
entries.quote: The year 2024 could be a watershed one for autonomous trucking as companies begin larger-scale on-the-road pilots.
entries.subject: Autonomous trucking

entries.label: Future of bioengineering
entries.quote: The combination of biological and computing advancements has led to a range of innovations in products and services for industries such as healthcare, food and agriculture, consumer products, sustainability, and energy and materials.
entries.subject: Bioengineering
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $62 billion; job postings 2022–23: –23%.

entries.label: Future of space technologies
entries.quote: Rapidly decreasing technology costs over the past decade have given rise to an increase in the viability and relevance of space technologies.
entries.subject: Space technologies
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $9 billion; job postings 2022–23: –9%.

entries.label: Future of space technologies
entries.quote: Revenues of the industry’s “backbone”—that is, space hardware and service providers—could potentially grow to more than $750 billion by 2035
entries.subject: Space industry backbone revenue
entries.metric: revenue of space hardware and service providers

entries.label: Electrification and renewables
entries.quote: Electrification and renewable-energy technologies are crucial for reducing global carbon emissions in accordance with the Paris Agreement.
entries.subject: Electrification and renewable energy
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $183 billion; job postings 2022–23: +1%.

entries.label: Electrification and renewables
entries.quote: McKinsey research estimates that climate technology value chains will require approximately 200 million skilled workers globally by 2050.
entries.subject: Climate technology workforce
entries.metric: skilled workers required by climate technology value chains
entries.note: A requirement estimate rather than an outcome forecast; kept because it names a year and a number.

entries.label: Climate technologies beyond electrification and renewables
entries.quote: Climate technologies beyond electrification and renewables cover technologies related to circularity and resources and carbon capture and removal.
entries.subject: Climate technologies (CCUS, carbon removal, circularity)
entries.note: Report states (past-year context, not a forecast): equity investment 2023: $68 billion; job postings 2022–23: –11%.
